description: Register the user's interest in DeepDNA's private beta (DNA file parsing, annotation, bloodwork; not deployed yet). Only call this after the user has explicitly agreed to share their email with DeepDNA for this purpose, and set user_consent to true. Stores the email and the optional use case; see https://deepdna.ai/privacy/.

use_case.description: Optional. What the user is building, in a sentence or two. Max 500 characters.

user_consent.description: Must be true: the user agreed to share their email with DeepDNA for the private beta.

name: request_beta_access
title: Request private beta access
